Mishneh Torah, Shofar, Sukkah and Lulav: Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturim min hassukka. tumtum veanderoginus chayyavim missafek. vechen mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin chayyav. katan sheeno tzarich leimmo shehu [keven chamesh] keven shesh chayyav besukka middivre sofrim kede lechannecho bemitzvot:

Cholim umeshammeshehen peturim min hassukka. velo chole sheyyesh bo sakkana ella afillu chash berosho vaafillu chash beenav. mitztaer patur min hassukka hu velo meshammeshav. veezehu mitztaer ze sheeno yachol lishon bassukka mippene haruach o mippene hazzevuvim vehapparoshim vechayyotze bahen o mippene hareach:
Haavel chayyav besukka. vechatan vechol hashshoshvinin vechol bene chuppa peturim min hassukka kol shivat yeme hammishte:

Sheluche mitzva peturim min hassukka ben bayyom uven ballayla. holche derachim bayyom peturim min hassukka bayyom vechayyavin ballayla. holche derachim ballayla peturim min hassukka ballayla vechayyavim bayyom. shomre hair bayyom peturim min hassukka bayyom vechayyavim ballayla. shomre hair ballayla peturim min hassukka ballayla vechayyavim bayyom. shomre ginnot ufardesin peturin ben bayyom uven ballayla sheim yaase hashshomer sukka yeda haggannav sheyyesh lashshomer makom kavua veyavo veyignov min makom acher:

Ketzad hi mitzvat hayeshiva bassukka. sheyyihye ochel veshote vedar bassukka kol shivat hayyamim ben bayyom uven ballayla kederech shehu dar beveto bishar yemot hashshana. vechol shivat hayyamim ose adam et beto aray veet sukkato keva shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 42)</small> "bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim". ketzad. kelim hannaim umatztzaot hannaot bassukka. uchele shetiyya kegon ashishot vechosot bassukka. aval kele achila kegon kederot ukearot chutz lasukka. hammenora bassukka. veim hayta sukka ketanna mannichah chutz lassukka:

Ochlin veshotin vishenim bassukka kol shiva ben bayyom uven ballayla. veasur leechol seudda chutz lasukka kol shiva ella im achal achilat aray kevetza o pachot o yeter meat. veen yeshenim chutz lasukka afillu shenat aray. umuttar lishtot mayim veleechol perot chutz lassukka. umi sheyyachamir al atzmo velo yishte chutz lasukka afillu mayim hare ze meshubbach:

Achila belele yom tov harishon bassukka chova. afillu achal kezayit pat yatza yede chovato. mikkan veelach reshut. ratza leechol seudda soed bassukka. ratza eno ochel kol shiva ella perot o kelayot chutz lassukka ochel kedin achilat matztza befesach:

Mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch beto o chutz lassukka veochel hare ze asur ucheillu lo achal bassukka ad sheyyihye shulchano betoch hassukka. gezera shemma yimmashech achar shulchano. vaafillu besukka gedola:
Kol shivat hayyamim kore betoch hassukka. ucheshemmevin umedakdek bema sheyyikra yavin chutz lasukka kede shettihye dato meyushshevet alav. hammitpallel ratza mitpallel bassukka o chutz lassukka:

Yardu geshamim hare ze nichnas letoch habbayit. meematay muttar lippanot, mishsheyyardu letoch hassukka tippot sheim yippelu letoch hattavshil yippasel, afillu tavshil shel pol. haya ochel bassukka veyardu geshamim venichnas leveto ufasku haggeshamim en mechayyevim oto lachazor lassukka (kol oto hallayla) ad sheyyigmor seuddato. haya yashen veyardu geshamim ballayla venichnas letoch habbayit ufasku haggeshamim en matrichin oto lachazor lasukka kol oto hallayla ella yashen beveto ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar:

Gamar milleechol bayyom hashshevii beshacharit lo yattir sukkato. aval morid hu et kelav umefanne otan min hammincha ulemala. en lo makom lefannot pochet bah arbaa al arbaa. veim hutzrach lisod bishar hayyom tzarich leechol bassukka, shemmitzvatah kol shiva:

Kol zeman sheyyikkanes leshev bassukka kol shiva mevarech kodem sheyyeshev asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu leshev bassukka. uvelele yom tov harishon mevarech al hassukka veachar kach al hazzeman. umesadder kol habberachot al hakkos. nimtza mekaddesh meummad umevarech leshev bassukka veyoshev veachar kach mevarech al hazzeman. vechaze haya minhag rabbotay verabbane sefarad lekaddesh meemmad belayil rishon shel chag hassukkot kemo shebbearnu:

Bazzeman hazze sheanu osin shene yamim tovim. yoshvin bassukka shemona yamim. uvayyom hashshemini shehu yom tov rishon shel shemini atzeret yoshvin bah veen mevarchin leshev bassukka. vechen tumtum veanderoginus leolam en mevarchin leshev bassukka mippene shehen chayyavim missafek veen mevarchin missafek:

Gamar milleechol bayyom hashshemini morid kelav umefanne otah. en lo makom lehorid et kelav im hayta ketanna machnis bah menora. veim hayta gedola machnis bah kederot ukearot vechayyotze bahen kede lehazekir shehi pesula veshekkevar nigmera mitzvatah umippene shehu yom tov eno yachol lifchot bah ulefaslah:

Mi shello asa sukka ben beshogeg ben bemezid ose sukka bechullo shel moed. afillu besof yom shevii ose sukka, shemmitzvatah kol shiva. atze sukka asurin kol shemonat yeme hechag ben atze defanot ben atze sechach en neotin mehen ledavar acher kol shemonat hayyamim mippene sheyyom hashshevii kullo hassukka muktza ad ben hashshemashot vehoil vehuktzat leven hashshemashot shel shemini huktzat lechol hayyom:

Vechen ochalin umashkin shettolin bassukka kede lenaotah asur lehistappek mehen kol shemona. veim hitna alehen beshaa shettelaan veamar eni bodel mehen kol ben hashshemashot hare ze mistappek mehen bechol et sheyyirtze. shehare lo hiktza otam velo chala alehen kedushshat hassukka velo nechshevu kemotah:

<small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "kappot temarim" haamurot battora hen charayot shel dekel kesheyyitzmechu kodem sheyyitpardu healin shellahen lechan ulechan ella kesheyyihye kemo sharvit. vehu hannikra lulav: 
<small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "peri etz hadar" haamur battora hu etrog. <small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "vaanaf etz avot" haamur battora hu hahadas shealav chofin et etzo. kegon sheyyihyu shelosha alin o yeter al ken begivol echad. aval im hayu shene healin beshave ze keneged ze veheale hashshelishi lemala mehen en ze avot aval nikra hadas shote: 
<small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "arve nachal" haamurot battora enan kol davar haggadel al hannachal ella min yadua hu hannikra arve nachal. ale shello mashuch kenachal ufiv chalak vekane shello adom veze hu hannikra arava. verov min ze gadel al hannechalim lechach neemar arve nachal. vaafillu haya gadel bammidbar o beharim kasher: 
Veyesh min acher dome laarava ella sheale shello agol ufiv dome lemassar vekane shello eno adom vezehu hannikra tzaftzafa vehi pesula. veyesh sham min arava sheen pi heale shellah chalak veeno kemassar ella yesh bo telamim ketannim ad meod kemo pi maggal katan veze kasher. vechol haddevarim haellu mippi hashshemua mimmoshe rabbenu nitparshu: 
Arbaa minin ellu mitzva achat hen umeakkevin ze et ze vechullan nikraim mitzvat lulav. veen pochatin mehen veen mosifin alehen. veim lo nimtza echad mehen en meviim tachtav min acher haddome lo: 
Mitzva min hammuvchar leegod lulav vahadas vaarava velaasot shelashtan agudda achat. ucheshehu notlam latzet bahen mevarech techilla al netilat lulav hoil vechullan semuchin lo veachar kach notel haagudda hazzot bimino veetrog bismolo venotlan derech gedilatan sheyyihyu ikkerehen lematta laaretz verashehen lemala laavir. veim lo agadan unetalan echad echad yatza vehu sheyyihyu arbatan metzuyin etzlo. aval im lo haya lo ella min echad o shechaser min echad lo yittol ad sheyyimtza hashshear: 
Kamma notel mehen. lulav echad veetrog echad ushene badde arava ushelosha badde hadas. veim ratza lehosif bahadas kede shettihye agudda gedola mosif. venoye mitzva hu. aval shear hamminin en mosifin al minyanam veen gorin mehen. veim hosif o gara (pasul): 
Kamma shiur orech kol min mehem. lulav en pachot mearbaa tefachim veim haya aroch kol shehu kasher. umedidato mishshidrato bilvad lo merosh healim. vahadas vaarava en pachot mishshelosha tefachim. veim hayu arukkin kol shehen kesherim. vaafillu en bechol bad uvad ella shelosha alin lachin kesherim vehu sheyyihyu berosh habbad. veim agad hallulav tzarich sheyyihye shedero shel lulav yotze min hahadas vaarava tefach o yoter. veshiur etrog en pachot mikkevetza veim haya gadol kol shehu kasher: 
Mishsheyyagbiah arbaa minin ellu ben shehigbihan keachat ben baze achar ze ben beyamin ben bismol yatza. vehu sheyyagbihan derech gedilatan. aval shello derech gedilatan lo yatza. umitzva kehilchatah sheyyagbiah agudda shel shelosha minin beyamin veetrog bismol veyolich veyavi veyaale veyorid vinaanea hallulav shelosha peamim bechol ruach veruach: 
Ketzad. molich umenanea rosh hallulav shalosh peamim umevi umenanea rosh hallulav shalosh peamim vechen baaliyya virida. vehechan molich umevi. bishat keriat hahallel b <small>(Tehillim 118 1)</small> <small>(Tehillim 118 29)</small> "hodu laAdonai ki tov" techilla vasof uv<small>(Tehillim 118 25)</small> "anna Adonai hoshia na". vechol hayyom kasher lintilat lulav veeno notel ballayla: 
Asa laagudda zo gimon shel kesef veshel zahav o shekkarach aleha sadin unetalah yatza. lekicha al yede davar acher shemah lekicha. vehu sheyyihye derech kavod vederech hiddur shekkol shehu lenaoto eno chotzetz. aval im natan et hamminin haellu beatzitz o bikdera unetalah lo yatza yede chovato: 
Agad et hallulav im hahadas vehaarava vehivdil ben hallulav uven hahadas bematlat vechayyotze bah hare ze chotzetz. hivdil benehen baale hadas eno chotzetz. shemmin bemino eno chotzetz. veyesh lo leegod et hallulav bechut o bimshicha uvechol min sheyyirtze hoil veen agidato meakkev: 
Mitzvat lulav lehinnatel beyom rishon shel chag bilvad bechol makom uvechol zeman vaafillu beshabbat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon". uvammikdash levaddo notlin oto bechol yom vayom mishshivat yeme hechag shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem" vegomer. chal yom hashshabbat lihyot betoch yeme hechag eno nittal beshabbat gezera shemma yolichennu beyado arba ammot birshut harabbim kemo sheggazru beshofar: 
Velamma lo gazru gezera zo beyom tov harishon mippene shehu mitzva min hattora vaafillu bigvulin. nimtza sheen dino vedin shear hayyamim shave shebbishar yeme hechag en adam chayyav littol lulav ella bammikdash: 
Mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkinu sheyyihye lulav nittal bechol makom kol shivat yeme hechag zecher lammikdash. vechol yom vayom mevarech alav asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat lulav mippene shehi mitzva middivre sofrim. vetakkana zo im kol hattakkanot shehitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay mishshecharav bet hammikdash kesheyyibbane bet hammikdash yachzeru haddevarim leyashnan: 
Bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam haya lulav nittal bayyom harishon shechal lihyot beshabbat. vechen bishar hammekomot sheyyadu bevadday sheyyom ze hu yom hechag beeretz yisrael. aval hammekomot harchokim shello hayu yodim bikviut rosh chodesh lo hayu notlin hallulav missafek: 
Umishshecharav bet hammikdash asru chachamim littol et hallulav beshabbat bayyom harishon vaafillu bene eretz yisrael shekkiddeshu et hachodesh. mippene bene haggevulin harchokim sheenan yodin bikviat hachodesh. kede sheyyihyu hakkol shavin bedavar ze velo yihyu ellu notlin beshabbat veellu en notlin. hoil vechiyyuv yom rishon bechol makom echad hu veen sham mikdash lehittalot bo: 
Uvazzeman hazze shehakkol osin al pi hacheshbon nishar haddavar kemot shehaya shello yinnatel lulav beshabbat kelal lo bigvulin velo beeretz yisrael vaafillu beyom rishon. veaf al pi shehakkol yodim bikviat hachodesh. uchevar bearnu sheikkar haissur bintilat hallulav beshabbat gezera shemma yaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim: 
Kol shechayyav beshofar uvesukka chayyav bintilat hallulav. vechol happatur mishshofar vesukka patur minnetilat lulav. katan hayyodea lenaanea chayyav belulav middivre sofrim kede lechannecho bemitzvot: 
Halacha lemoshe missinay shemmeviin bammikdash arava acheret chutz mearava shebballulav. veen adam yotze yede chovato baarava shebballulav. veshiurah afillu ale echad bevad echad: 
Ketzad hayta mitzvatah. bechol yom vayom mishshivat hayyamim hayu meviin murbiyyot shel arava vezokfin otan al tzidde hammizbeach verashehen kefufin al gabbe hammizbeach. uveet shehayu meviin otah vesodrin otah tokin umeriin vetokin. chal yom shabbat lihyot betoch hechag en zokfin arava ella im ken chal yom shevii lihyot beshabbat zokfin otah beshabbat kede lefarsemah shehi mitzva: 
Ketzad hayu osin. meviin otah meerev shabbat lammikdash umannichin otah begiggiyyot shel zahav kede shello yichmeshu healin. ulemachar zokfin otah al gabbe hammizbeach uvain haam velokchin mimmenna venotlin otah kederech sheosin bechol yom. vaarava zo hoil veenah beferush battora en notlin otah kol shivat yeme hechag zecher lammikdash ella bayyom hashshevii bilvad hu shennotlin otah bazzeman hazze. ketzad ose. lokeach bad echad o baddin harebe chutz mearava shebballulav vechovet bah al hakkarka o al hakkeli paamayim o shalosh belo beracha sheddavar ze minhag neviim hu: 
Bechol yom vayom hayu makkifin et hammizbeach belulevehen bidehen paam achat veomrin <small>(Tehillim 118 25)</small> "anna Adonai hoshia na". <small>(Tehillim 118 25)</small> "anna Adonai hatzelicha na". uvayyom hashshevii makkifin et hammizbeach sheva peamim. uchevar nahagu yisrael bechol hammekomot lehanniach teva beemtza bet hakkeneset umakkifin otah bechol yom kederech shehayu makkifin et hammizbeach zecher lammikdash: 
Kach haya hamminhag birushalayim. yotze adam mibbeto shacharit velulavo beyado. venichnas levayit hakkeneset vehu beyado. mitpallel vehu beyado. veyotze levakker cholim ulenachem avelim vehu beyado. uchesheyyikkanes lammidrash meshallecho leveto beyad beno o beyad avdo: 
Mekabbelet ishsha hallulav miyyad benah o miyyad balah umachzirato lammayim beshabbat bizman shehayu notlin lulav beshabbat. uveyom tov mosifin al hammayim uvammoed machlifin hammayim: 
Hadas shebballulav asur lehariach bo mippene sheeno rauy ella lereach vehoil vehuktza lemitzva asur lehariach bo. aval etrog muttar lehariach bo shehare huktza lemitzva meachila: 
Veasur leechol etrog kol yom hashshevii mippene shehuktza lemiktzat hayyom huktza lechullo. uvashshemini muttar baachila. uvazzeman hazze sheanu osin shene yamim af al pi sheen notlin lulav bashshemini haetrog asur bashshemini kederech shehaya asur bashshemini bizman shehayu osin shene yamim mippene hassafek shehu sefek shevii. hifrish shiva etrogin leshivat yamim kol achat veachat yotze bah leyomah veochlah lemachar:

Arvaat minin haellu shehen lulav vahadas vaarava veetrog shehaya echad mehen yavesh o gazul o ganuv afillu leachar yeush o sheyyihye meashera hanneevedet af al pi shebbittelu haashera milleavdah. o shehaya shel ir hanniddachat. hare ze pasul. haya echad mehen shel avodat kochavim lo yittol lechattechilla veim natal yatza. haya kamush velo gamar livash kasher. uvishat haddechak o bishat hassakkana lulav hayyavesh kasher aval lo shear hamminin:

Etrog shel arla veshel teruma temea veshel tevel pasul. shel demay kasher sheefshar sheyyafkir nechasav veyihye ani shemmuttar lo leechol demay. etrog shel teruma tehora veshel maaser sheni birushalayim lo yittol shemma yachshiro letuma. veim natal kasher:

Lulav shenniktam rosho pasul. nisdak im nitrachaku shene sedakav ze mizze ad sheyyerau kishnayim pasul. haya akum lefanav shehare shedero kegav baal chatoteret pasul. haya akum laachorav kasher shezzo hi beriyyato. neekam leechad mitztzedadav pasul. nifredu alav ze meal ze velo niddaldelu kaale hacharayot kasher. nifretzu alav vehu sheyyiddaldelu mishshedero shel lulav kaale hacharayot pasul:

Beriyyat alin shel lulav kach hi. keshehem gedelin gedelin shenayim shenayim udevukin miggabban vegav kol shene alin haddevukin hu hannikra teyomet. nechleka hatteyomet pasul. hayu alav achat achat mittechillat beriyyato vlo haya lahem teyomet pasul. lo hayu alav ze al gav ze kederech kol hallulavin ella ze tachat ze im rosh ze maggia laikkar shellemala mimmennu ad shennimtza kol shedero shel lulav mechusse bealin kasher. veim en rosho shel ze maggia letzad ikkaro shel ze pasul:

Hadas shenniktam rosho kasher. nashru rov alav im nishtayyeru shelosha alin beken echad kasher. hayu anavav merubbot mealav im yerukkot kasher veim adummot o shechorot pasul. veim miatan kasher. veen memaatin otan beyom tov lefi shehu kimtakken. avar velikketan o shellikketan echad echad laachila hare ze kasher:
Arava shenniktam roshah keshera. nifretzu aleha pesula:

Etrog shennikkav nekev mefullash kol shehu pasul. vesheeno mefullash im haya keisar o yeter pasul. chaser kol shehu pasul. nittal dado vehu harosh hakkatan sheshshoshanto bo pasul. nittal haetz shehu taluy bo bailan meikkar haetrog venishar mekomo guma pasul. alta chazazit alav im bishnayim ushelosha mekomot pasul. veim bemakom echad im alta al rubbo pasul. veim al dado vaafillu kol shehu pasul. niklaf hakkerum hachitzona shello sheeno mechassero ella nishar yarok kemot shehi beriyyato im niklaf kullo pasul veim nishar mimmennu kol shehu kasher:

Etrog shehu tafuach saruach kavush shaluk shachor lavan menummar yarok kecharti pasul. giddelo bidfus veasahu kemin beriyya acheret pasul. asahu kemin beriyyato af al pi sheasahu dappin dappin kasher. hattiom vehabboser kasher. makom shehaetrogin shellahem keen shacharut meuta kesherin. veim hayu shechorim beyoter keadam kushi hare ze pasul bechol makom:

Kol ellu sheamarnu shehem pesulin mippene mumin shebbearnu o mippene gezel ugeneva beyom tov rishon bilvad aval beyom tov sheni im shear hayyamim hakkol kasher. vehappaslanut shehu mishshum avodat kochavim o mippene sheoto etrog asur baachila ben beyom tov rishon ben bishar yamim pasul:

En adam yotze beyom tov rishon shel chag belulavo shel chavero sheyyishalennu mimmennu ad sheyyittenennu lo bemattana. netano lo al menat lehachaziro hare ze yotze bo yede chovato umachaziro. shemmattana al menat lehachazir shemah mattana. veim lo hechziro lo yatza shennimtza kegazul. veen notnin oto lekatan shehakkatan kone veeno makne laacherim min hattora venimtza sheim hechziro lo eno chozer. veechad hallulav veechad kol min vamin mearba minin shebbo im haya echad mehen shaul en yotzin bo beyom tov rishon:

Shuttafin shekkanu lulav o etrog beshuttafut en echad mehen yotze bo yede chovato barishon ad sheyyitten lo chelko bemattana. haachin shekkanu etrogin mittefisat habbayit venatal echad mehen etrog veyatza bo. im yachol leachlo veen haachin makpidin bechach yatza. veim hayu makpidin lo yatza ad sheyyittenu lo chelkam bemattana. veim kana ze etrog veze parish o shekkanu keechad etrog verimmon ufarish mittefisat habbayit eno yotze baetrog ad sheyyitten lo chelko bemattana veaf al pi sheim achalo en makpidin alav:

Af al pi shekkol hammoadot mitzva lismoach bahen. bechag hassukkot hayta bammikdash yom simcha yetera shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem shivat yamim". vechetzad hayu osin. erev yom tov harishon hayu metakkenin bammikdash makom lannashim millemala velaanashim millematta kede shello yitarvu ellu im ellu. umatchilin lismoach mimmotzae yom tov harishon. vechen bechol yom veyom mime chullo shel moed matchilin meachar sheyyakrivu tamid shel ben haarbayim lismoach lishar hayyom im kol hallayla:

Veheach hayta simcha zo. hechalil makke umenaggenin bechinnor uvinvalim uvimtziltayim vechol echad veechad bichle shir shehu yodea lenaggen bo. umi sheyyodea bappe bappe. verokdin umesappekin umetappechin umefazzezin umecharkerin kol echad veechad kemo sheyyodea veomrim divre shirot vetushbachot. vesimcha zo enah docha lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov:

Mitzva leharebot besimcha zo. velo hayu osin otah amme haaretz vechol mi sheyyirtze. ella gedole chachme yisrael verashe hayeshivot vehassanhedrin vehachasidim vehazzekenim veanshe maase hem shehayu merakkedin umesappekin umenaggenin umesammechin bammikdash bime chag hassukkot. aval kol haam haanashim vehannashim kullan bain lirot velishmoa:

Hassimcha sheyyismach adam baasiyyat hammitzva uveahavat hael shetztzivva bahen. avoda gedola hi. vechol hammonea atzmo missimcha zo rauy lehippara mimmennu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 28 47)</small> "tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav". vechol hammegis dato vecholek kavod leatzmo umitkabbed beenav bimkomot ellu chote veshote. veal ze hizhir shelomo veamar <small>(Mishlei 25 6)</small> "al tithaddar lifne melech". vechol hammashpil atzmo umekel gufo bimkomot ellu hu haggadol hamechubbad haoved meahava. vechen david melech yisrael amar <small>(Shmuel 2 6 22)</small> "unekalloti od mizzot vehayiti shafal beenay". veen haggedulla vehakkavod ella lismoach lifne Adonai shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 6 16)</small> "vehammelech david mefazzez umecharker lifne Adonai": salik hilchot shoppar sukka velulav
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 1:
Mitzvat ase min hattora litten kol ish miyyisrael machatzit hashshekel bechol shana veshana. afillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka chayyav. veshoel meacherim o mocher kesut sheal ketefo venoten machatzit hashshekel kesef shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 15)</small> "heashir lo yarbe vehaddal lo yamit" vegomer. veeno notno bifamim rabbot hayyom meat ulemachar meat ella notno kullo keachat befaam achat: 
Minyan kesef haamur battora beones uvimfatte uvemotzi shem ra vehoreg eved hu kesef hu shekel hanneemar bechol makom battora. umishkalo shelosh meot veesrim seora. uchevar hosifu chachamim alav veasu mishkalo kemishkal hammatbea hannikra sela bizman bayit sheni. vechamma hu mishkal hassela shelosh meot vearba ushemonim seora benonit: 
Hassela arbaa dinarin vehaddinar shesh main. umaa hi hannikret bime moshe rabbenu gera. umaa hi shene punedyonin ufunedyon shene isarin. uferuta achat mishshemona beisar. nimtza mishkal hammaa vehi haggera shesh esre seorot. umishkal haisar arba seorot. umishkal happeruta chatzi seora: 
Veod matbea acher haya sham shehaya mishkalo shete selaim vehu haya nikra darkon. veellu hammatbeot kullan sheamarnu uvearnu mishkal kol echad mehen hen shemmeshaarin bahen bechol makom. uchevar bearnum kede shello ehye tzarich lefaresh mishkalam bechol makom: 
Machatzit hashshekel zo mitzvatah sheyyitten machatzit matbea shel oto hazzeman afillu haya oto matbea gadol mishshekel hakkodesh. uleolam eno shokel pachot mechatzi hashshekel shehaya bime moshe rabbenu shehu mishkalo mea veshishshim seora: 
Bizman shehaya matbea shel oto zeman darkonot haya kol echad veechad noten bemachatzit hashshekel shello sela. uvizman shehaya hammatbea selaim haya noten kol echad bemachatzit hashshekel shello chatzi sela shehu shene dinarin. uvizman shehaya hammatbea chatzi sela haya kol echad veechad noten bemachatzit hashshekel oto chatzi hassela. umeolam lo shaklu yisrael bemachatzit hashshekel pachot mechatzi shekel shel tora: 
Hakkol chayyavin litten machatzit hashshekel kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim vegerim vaavadim meshuchrarim. aval lo nashim velo avadim velo ketannim. veim natnu mekabbelin mehem. aval hakkutim shennatnu machatzit hashshekel en mekabbelin mehem. katan shehitchil aviv litten alav machatzit hashshekel shuv eno posek ella noten alav bechol shana veshana ad sheyyagdil veyitten al atzmo: 
Hashshekalim enan nohagin ella bifne habbayit. uvizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam notnin et hashshekalim ben beeretz yisrael ben bechutza laaretz. uvizman shehu charev afillu beeretz yisrael en nohagin: 
Beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim kede sheyyachin kol echad veechad machatzit hashshekel shello. veyihye atid litten. bachamishsha asar bo yashvu hashshulchanim bechol medina umedina vetovin benachat kol mi sheyyitten lahem yekabbelu mimmennu umi shello natan en kofin oto litten. bachamishsha veesrim bo yashvu bammikdash ligbot. umikkan veelach kofin et mi shello natan ad sheyyitten. vechol mi shello yitten memashkenin oto velokchin avoto baal karcho vaafillu kesuto: 
Kol mi sheeno chayyav bishkalim af al pi sheddarko litten o hu atid litten en memashkenin oto. veen memashkenin et hakkohanim leolam mippene darche shalom ella kesheyyittenu mekabbelin mehen vetovin otan ad sheyyittenu:
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 2:
Ketzad konsin hashshulchanim et hashshekalim bechol medina umedina. mannichin lifnehem shete tevot shule hatteva rechavin millematta ufiha tzar millemala kemin shofar kede sheyyashlichu letochan velo yihye efshar likkach mehen benachat. velamma osin shete tevot. achat shemmashlichin bah shekalim shel shana zo. vehashsheniyya mannichin bah shikle shana sheavra. sheggovin mimmi shello shakal beshana sheavra: 
Uvammikdash haya lifnehem tamid shelosh esre tevot. kol teva kemin shofar. rishona leshikle shana zo. sheniyya leshikle shana sheavra. shelishit lechol mi sheyyesh alav karban shete torim o shene bene yona echad ola veechad chattat mashlich demehen leteva zo. reviit lechol mi sheyyesh alav olat haof bilvad mashlich dameha leteva zo. chamishit lemi shehitnaddev maot liknot etzim lammaaracha bahen. shishshit lemi shehitnaddev maot lilvona. sheviit lemi shehitnaddev zahav lakkapporet. sheminit lemotar chattat kegon shehifrish maot lechattato velakach chattat vehotir min hammaot yashlich hashshear letochah. teshiit lemotar asham. asirit lemotar kinne zavim vezavot veyoldot. achat esre lemotar karbenot nazir. shetem esre lemotar asham metzora. shelosh esre lemi shehitnaddev maot leolat behema: 
Veshem kol davar sheyyihyu maotav betoch hatteva katuv al hatteva mibbachutz. utenay bet din hu al kol hammotarot sheyyikkarvu olat behema. nimtzeta lamed shekkol hammaot hannimtzaot beshesh hattevot haacharonot leolat behema veoroteha lakkohanim kishar kol haorot. vechol hammaot shebbeteva shelishit likkach bahen ofot chetzyan olot vechetzyan chattaot. veshebbarviit kullan olat haof: 
Bechol medina umedina kesheggovin hashshekalim meshallechin otan beyad sheluchim lammikdash. veyesh lahem letzaref otan bedinre zahav mippene massooy hadderech. vehakkol mitkabbetzin lammikdash umannichin otan belishka achat min halleshachot bammikdash vesogrin kol daltoteha bemaftechot vechotmin aleha chotamot umemallein mikkol hashshekalim sheyyitkabbetzu sham shalosh kuppot gedolot shiur kol kuppa kede shettachil tesha sein vehashshear mannichin oto ballishka. veze shebbetoch hakkuppot hu hannikra terumat hallishka veze sheyyishshaer sham yeter al ma sheyyesh bakkuppot hu hannikra sheyare hallishka: 
Bishlosha perakim bashshana tormin et hallishka. berosh chodesh nisan. uverosh chodesh tishre kodem yom tov o acharav. vekodem atzeret bachamishsha asar yom. vechetzad tormin otah. echad nichnas lifnim min hallishka vehashshomrin omdim bachutz vehu omer lahem etrom vehen omrim lo terom terom terom shelosha peamim. veachar kach memalle shalosh kuppot ketannot kol kuppa mehen mechila shalosh sein meotan shalosh kuppot haggedolot umotzian lachutz kede lehistappek mehen ad sheyyichlu. vechozer umemalle otan hashshalosh kuppot hakketannot min shalosh gedolot paam sheniyya kodem atzeret umistappekin mehen ad sheyyichlu: 
Vechozer umemalle otan paam shelishit min hashshalosh kuppot haggedolot betishre umistappekin mehen ad sheyyichlu ad rosh chodesh nisan. uverosh chodesh nisan tormin mitteruma chadasha. lo hispiku lahen hashshekalim shebbeshalosh kuppot haggedolot vechalu ad shello higgia nisan chozrin vetormin mishsheyare hallishka: 
Shalosh kuppot hakketannot shehu torem bahem umotzian lachutz katuv alehen alef bet gimel kede sheyyistappeku min harishona ad shettichle. veachar kach mistappekin min hashsheniyya. veachar kach mistappekin min hashshelishit. vetorem rishona min hakkuppa haachat haggedola umechappe otah haggedola bemitpachat. vetorem hashsheniyya mehakkuppa haggedola hashsheniyya umechappe otah haggedola bemitpachat. vetorem hashshelishit min hakkuppa haggedola hashshelishit veeno mechappe otah bemitpachat kede shettihye nikkeret shebbah siyyem. veyatchil mimmenna battechilla befaam sheniyya kesheyyikkanes kodem atzeret. vetorem harishona min haggedola shehayta megulla umechappe otah. vetorem hashsheniyya min haggedola shettaram mimmenna barishona techilla umechappe otah. vetorem hashshelishit min haggedola hassemucha lah veeno mechappe otah kede sheyyatchil mimmenna battechilla befaam shelishit kesheyyikkanes betishre. ad shennimtza torem rishona usheniyya ushelishit hakketannot mikkol achat veachat min haggedolot: 
Keshehu torem shalosh kuppot ellu torem et harishona leshem eretz yisrael. vehashsheniyya leshem hakkerakkin hammukkafin lah uleshem kol (eretz) yisrael. vehashshelishit leshem bavel uleshem maday uleshem hammedinot harchokot uleshem shear kol yisrael: 
Keshehu torem mitkavven litrom al haggavuy sheyyesh ballishka. veal haggavuy sheadayin lo higgia lallishka. veal heatid liggavot kede sheyyihyu ellu hashshekalim shehotzian lehistappek mehen kappara al kol yisrael ucheillu higgiu kol shiklehen lallishka venitrema mehen teruma zo: 
Kesheyyikkanes hattorem litrom lo yikkanes beveged sheefshar lehachebot bo kesef velo beminal velo besandal velo bitfilla velo bekamea shemma yachshedu oto haam veyomru hechbi mimmeot hallishka tachtav keshetteramah. umedabberim hayu immo mishshaa sheyyikkanes ad shaa sheyyetze kede shello yitten letoch piv. veaf al pi shennizharim kol kach ani o mi shehu nivhal lahon lo yitrom mippene hachashad shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 32 22)</small> "vihyitem nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael":
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 3:
Chatzaye hashshekalim hakkol tzerichin lahen kede sheyyitten kol echad veechad chatzi shekel shehu chayyav. lefichach keshehaya adam holech etzel hashshulchani umetzaref shekel bishne chatzain yitten lo tosefet al hashshekel. veotah hattosefet nikret kalbon. lefichach shenayim shennatnu shekel al shenehem chayyavin bekalbon: 
Kol mi sheeno chayyav bishkalim kegon shete nashim o shene avadim shennatnu shekel peturim min hakkalbon. vechen im haya echad chayyav veechad patur venatan hachayyav al yad happetur kegon ish shennatan shekel alav veal ishsha o eved patur min hakkalbon. vechen hakkohanim peturin min hakkalbon vehashshokel al yad hakkohen patur min hakkalbon: 
Hannoten shekel alav veal heani o al shecheno o al ben iro. im netano lahem mattana patur min hakkalbon. shehare natan chatzi shekel mattana kede leharebot bishkalim. veim natan lahem hachatzi sheshshakal al yadam derech halevaa ad sheyyachaziru lo keshettimtza yadam chayyav hakkalbon: 
Haachin sheadayin lo chalku ma shehinniach lahem avihem. vechen hashshuttafim shennatnu shekel al yede shenehem peturin min hakkalbon. bamme devarim amurim beshuttafin shennasu venatnu bimot hashshuttafut venishtanna en hammaot. aval im hevi ze meotav veze meotav veervum vaadayin lo nishtannu hammaot velo hotzium hare ellu chayyavin bekalbon. nasu venatnu veachar zeman chalku vechazru venishtattefu chayyavin bekalbon ad sheyyisseu veyittenu beshuttafut zo haacharona veyishtannu hammaot: 
Haachin vehashshuttafin shehaya lahen behema uchesafim vechalku bakkesafim chayyavim bekalbon. af al pi sheadayin lo chalku habbehema. veim chalku habbehema velo chalku hakkesafim peturin min hakkalbon ad sheyyachleku hakkesafim veen omrin hare hem omdin lachaluka: 
Hannoten shekel lehekdesh kede sheyyechashshevu lo machatzit hashshekel shehu chayyav bah veyittol chatzi shekel mimma shennigba min haacherim chayyav shene kalbonot. sheillu haya hashshekel kullo lishkalim haya chayyav kalbon echad: 
Kamma hu shiur hakkalbon. bizman shehayu notnin bemachatzit hashshekel shene dinarin haya hakkalbon chatzi maa shehu echad mishshenem asar bedinar. umeolam lo nittan hakkalbon pachot mizze. vehakkalbonot enan kishkalim ella mannichin otan hashshulchanim bifne atzman ad sheyyistappek mehen hahekdesh: 
Mi sheavad shiklo chayyav beachrayuto ad sheyyimserennu laggizbar. bene hair sheshshalchu et shiklehen beyad shaliach venignevu o avdu. im shomer chinnam hu hare ze nishba lahem veniftar kedin kol shomre chinnam vehen chozrin venotnin shiklehen paam sheniyya. veim amru anshe hair hoil veanu meshallemin shekalenu en retzonenu sheyyishshava hashshaliach shehu neeman lanu en shomin lahen. lefi shettakkanat chachamim hi sheen hekdesh yotze belo shevua. nimtzeu hashshekalim harishonim achar shennishba hashshaliach ellu veellu shekalim hem veen olin lahen leshana acheret. veharishonim yippelu leshikle hashshana vehaacharonim yippelu leshikle shana sheavra: 
Shalchu et shiklehem beyad shomer sachar shehare hu chayyav bigneva vaaveda veavdu mimmennu beones. kegon shellekachum listim mezuyyanim shehu patur. roin im achar shennitrema hatteruma neenas nishba hashshaliach laggizbarim uvene hair peturin. shehattorem torem al haggavuy veal heatid liggavot uvirshut hekdesh hen uvene hair me haya lahen laasot hare lo masru ella leshomer sachar shehu chayyav bigneva vaaveda. aval haones eno matzuy. veim avdu kodem shennitrema hatteruma adayin birshut bene hair hem vehashshaliach nishba lifne anshe hair vehen meshallemin. nishba vegavu shekalim shenit veachar kach hechezirum hallistim ellu veellu shekalim veen olin lahen leshana acheret vehashsheniyyim yippelu leshikle shana sheavra. yesh mi sheomer shehashshekalim harishonim sheyyippelu leshikle hashshana hem hashshekalim shenniggebu battechilla veavdu o neensu vechazru. veyesh mi sheomer shehashshekalim harishonim hen shehiggiu leyad haggizbar techilla: 
Hannoten chatzi shekel lachavero leholicho leshulchani lishkol oto al yado. halach ushekalo al yede atzmo kede shello yemashkenu oto. im nitrema hatteruma meal hashshokel shezze hashshekel birshut hekdesh hu shekkevar teramo al heatid ligbot venimtza ze hitztzil atzmo bemamon hahekdesh venehena bashshekel hazze. veim lo nitrema hatteruma lo maal vehu chayyav litten lachavero chatzi shekel shennatan lo. vechen haggozel o haggonev chatzi shekel ushekalo yatza vehu chayyav leshallem labbealim shenayim o lehosif chomesh: 
Hannoten machatzit hashshekel min hahekdesh venitrema hatteruma mimmennu. kesheyyistappeku mimmenna yitchayyev bimila veyatza yede machatzit hashshekel. netano mimmeot maaser sheni yochal kenegdo birushalayim. middeme sheviit yochal kenegdo bikdushshat sheviit. haya shel ir hanniddachat lo asa kelum: 
Hammafrish shiklo vesavur shehu chayyav bo venimtza sheeno chayyav lo kaddash. hammafrish shenayim venimtza sheeno chayyav ella echad. im beze achar ze haacharon lo kaddash. veim bevat achat haechad shekalim vehashsheni motar shekalim. hifrish shiklo vamet yippol lindava: 
Hallokeach maot beyado veamar ellu leshikli. o shehaya melakket maa maa o peruta peruta ucheshehitchil lelakket amar hareni melakket maot leshikli. afillu likket melo kis noten mehen chatzi shekel shehu chayyav bo vehashshear chullin shemmotar hashshekalim chullin: 
Maot shennimtzeu ben teva shel shekalim leteva shel nedava. karov lashshekalim yippelu lishkalim. karov lannedava yippelu lindava. mechetza al mechetza yippelu lindava mippene shehannedava kullah ola laishshim vehashshekalim mistappekin mehen leolot velidvarim acherim: 
Vechen kol hammaot hannimtzaim ben kol teva veteva yippelu lakkarov. nimtzeu mechetza lemechetza. im ben etzim lallevona nimtzeu yippelu lallevona. ben kinnim legozale ola yippelu legozale ola. ze hakkelal holchin achar hakkarov bechullan. mechetza lemechetza lehachamir. vechol hammaot hannimtzaot behar habbayit chullin sheen haggizbar motzi maot mitterumat hallishka ad shehu mechallelan al habbehemot shellokeach lekarbanot:
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 4: Terumat hallishka ma yease bah. lokchin mimmenna temidin shel kol yom vehammusafin vechol karbenot hatztzibbur veniskehem vehammelach shemmolchin bo kol hakkarbanot. vechen haetzim im lo heviu etzim velo nimtzeu ella bedamim. vehakketoret usechar asiyyatah. velechem happanim usechar ose lechem happanim. vehaomer ushete hallechem ufara adumma vesair hammishtalleach velashon shel zehorit shekkoshrin ben karnav. kol ellu bain mitterumat hallishka:

Aval par helem davar shel tzibbur useire avodat kochavim battechilla govin lahen veenan bain mitterumat hallishka. parochot shel hechol tachat binyan asuyot veenan bain mitterumat hallishka ella mikkadshe bedek habbayit. aval parochot shel shearim bain mitterumat hallishka. hammenora uchele sharet mitzvatan sheyyavou mimmotar hannesachim. uvehilchot kele hammikdash vehaovdim bo yitbaer ma hu motar hannesachim. veim lo haya lahen motar nesachim yaviu mitterumat hallishka. bigde kehunna ben bigde kohen gadol ben shear bigde hakkohanim sheovdin bahen bammikdash hakkol mitterumat hallishka:

Kol habbehemot hannimtzaot birushalayim o bechutza lah bekarov mimmenna baot olot kemo sheyyitbaer bifsule hammukdashin. niskehen bain mitterumat hallishka. vechen oved kochavim sheshshalach olato mimmedina acheret velo shalach immah deme nesachim yaviu niskehem mitterumat hallishka:

Ger shemmet vehinniach zevachim im yesh lo nesachim kerevin mishshello veim lav bain mitterumat hallishka. kohen gadol shemmet velo minnu acher tachtav makrivin et hachavitin mitterumat hallishka. mevakkere mumim shebbirushalayim vetalmide chachamim hamelammedim hilchot shechita lakkohanim vehilchot kemitza venashim hamegaddelot benehen lefara adumma kullan notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. vechamma hu secharan. kemo sheyyifseku lahen bet din:

Bishnat hashshemitta shehi hefker sochrin bet din shomrin sheyyishmeru miktzat sefichim shetztzamchu kede sheyyaviu mehen haomer ushete hallechem sheen baim ella min hechadash. veellu hashshomrin notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka:

Mi shehitnaddev lishmor bechinnam en shomin lo mishshum baale zeroa shemma yavou veyittelum mehen. lefichach tikkenu lahem chachamim sheyyittelu sachar min hallishka kede sheyyifreshu hakkol meoto makom sheellu shomrim sham:

Maggihe sefarim shebbirushalayim vedayyanin sheddanin et haggazlanin birushalayim notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. vechamma hayu notlim tishim mane bechol shana. veim lo hispiku lahen af al pi shello ratzu mosifin lahen kede tzarkan hem uneshehem uvenehem uvene betan:

Kevesh hayu bonin mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha shealav motziin para adumma. vechevesh shemmotziin alav sair hammishtalleach. ushenehem naasin mishsheyare hallishka. vechen mizbach haola vehahechol vehaazarot naasin mishsheyare hallishka. ammat hammayim shebbirushalayim vechomat yerushalayim vechol migdeloteha vechol tzarche hair bain mishsheyare hallishka. veoved kochavim shehitnaddev maot laddevarim haellu o laasot immahem bechinnam en mekabbelin mimmennu vaafillu ger toshav. shenneemar <small>(Ezra 4 3)</small> "lo lachem valanu livnot" vegomer veneemar <small>(Nechemya 2 20)</small> "velachem en chelek" vegomer:

Motar terumat hallishka usheyare hallishka lokchin bo zecharim vikarvu kullan olot shettenay bet din hu al kol hammotarot sheyyikrevu olat behema. aval lo olat haof sheen bekarbenot hatztzibbur of. veellu haolot habbain mimmotar hashshekalim hem hannikraim kayitz lammizbeach:
Shekalim shello hispiku lahen lechol karbenot hatztzibbur motziin et harauy lahem mikkadshe bedek habbayit. aval en bedek habbayit motzi et harauy lo mikkadshe hammizbeach:

Mishsheyaggia rosh chodesh nisan en makrivin karbenot tzibbur ella mitteruma chadasha. veim lo baa hachadasha lokchin min hayeshana. lefichach im higgia rosh chodesh nisan veyesh immahen behemot litmidim mitteruma yeshana podin otan veyotzin lechullin af al pi shehen temimin veyippelu demehen litruma yeshana shemmekitzin bah et hammizbeach. shettenay bet din hu al kol habbehemot shellokchin litmidin sheim lo yihyu tzerichin lahen yetzu lechullin:

Vechach hayu osin bemotar hakketoret. mishsheyaggia rosh chodesh nisan mechallelin oto al sechar haummanin vechozrin maot hassachar leketz hammizbeach venotlin haummanin motar hakketoret bischaran vechozrin velokchin et hakketoret mehen mitteruma chadasha kede lehakerivah mimmeot teruma chadasha. veim en lahen teruma chadasha maktirin otah mitteruma yeshana: salik lehu hilchot shekalim
Mishneh Torah, Sanctification of the New:
Chadshe hashshana hem chadshe hallevana shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 28 14)</small> "lat chodesh bechadsho" veneemar <small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim". kach amru chachamim hera lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe bemare hannevua demut levana veamar lo kaze ree vekaddesh. vehashshanim sheanu mechashshevin hem shene hachamma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 1)</small> "shamor et chodesh haaviv": 
Vechamma yetera shenat hachamma al shenat hallevana karov meachad asar yom. lefichach kesheyyitkabbetz min hattosefet hazzot kemo sheloshim yom o pachot meat o yoter meat mosifin chodesh echad veosin otah hashshana shelosha asar chodesh vehi hannikret shana meebberet. shei efshar lihyot hashshana shenem asar chodesh vechach vechach yamim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "lechadshe hashshana". chodashim atta mone leshana veen atta mone yamim: 
Hallevana nisteret bechol chodesh veenah niret kemo shene yamim o pachot o yoter meat. kemo yom echad kodem shettidbak bashshemesh besof hachodesh uchemo yom echad achar shettidbak bashshemesh veterae bammaarav baerev. uvallayil shetterae bammaarav achar shennistera hu techillat hachodesh umonin meoto hayyom tisha veesrim yom. veim yerae hayyareach lel sheloshim yihye yom sheloshim rosh hachodesh. veim lo yerae yihye rosh hachodesh yom echad usheloshim veyihye yom sheloshim mechodesh sheavar. veen nizkakin layyareach belel echad usheloshim ben shennira ben shello nira. sheen lecha chodesh levana yoter al sheloshim yom: 
Chodesh sheyyihye tisha veesrim veyerae yareach belel sheloshim nikra chodesh chaser. veim lo yerae hayyareach veyihye hachodesh sheavar sheloshim yom nikra chodesh meubbar venikra chodesh male. veyareach sheyyerae belel sheloshim hu hannikra yareach shennira bizmanno. veim nira belel echad usheloshim velo nira belel sheloshim hu nikra yareach shennira belel ibburo: 
En reiyyat hayyareach mesura lechol adam kemo shabbat bereshit shekkol echad mone shishsha veshovet bashshevii. ella levet din haddavar masur ad sheyyekaddeshuhu bet din veyikbeu oto hayyom rosh chodesh hu sheyyihye rosh chodesh. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "hachodesh hazze lachem" edut zo tihye mesura lachem: 
Bet din mechashshevin becheshbonot kederech shemmechashshevim haitztagninim sheyyodin mekomot hakkochavim umahalacham vechokrim umedakdekim ad sheyyedu im efshar sheyyerae hayyareach bizmanno shehu lel sheloshim o i efshar. im yadu sheefshar sheyyerae yoshvin umetzappin laedim kol hayyom kullo shehu yom sheloshim. im bau edim uderashum vachakarum kahalacha veneemnu divrehem mekaddeshin oto. veim lo nira velo bau edim mashlimin sheloshim veyihye chodesh meebbar. veim yadu becheshbon shei efshar sheyyerae en yoshvim yom sheloshim veen metzappin laedim. veim bau edim yodin bevadday shehen ede sheker o shenniret lahem demut levana min heavim veenah hallevana havvaddait: 
Mitzvat ase min hattora al bet din sheyyechashshevu veyedu im yerae hayyareach o lo yerae. vesheyyidreshu et haedim ad sheyyekaddeshu et hachodesh. veyishlechu veyodiu shear haam bee ze yom hu rosh chodesh kede sheyyedu bee ze yom hen hammoadot. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 2)</small> "asher tikreu otam mikrae kodesh" veneemar <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "veshamarta et hachukka hazzot lemoadah": 
En mechashshevin vekovin chodashim umeabberin shanim ella beeretz yisrael shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 2 3)</small> "ki mitztziyyon tetze tora udevar Adonai mirushalayim". veim haya adam gadol bechachma venismach beeretz yisrael veyatza lechutza laaretz velo hinniach beeretz yisrael kemoto hare ze mechashshev vekovea chodashim umeabber shanim bechutza laaretz. veim noda lo shennaasa beeretz yisrael adam gadol kemoto veen tzarich lomar gadol mimmennu hare ze asur likboa uleabber bechutza laaretz veim avar vekava veibber lo asa kelum:

En kasher leedut hachodesh ella shene anashim kesherim haruyin lehaid bechol davar vedavar. aval nashim vaavadim hare hen kishar pesule edut veen meidin. av uveno sherau et hayyareach yelchu levet din lehaid. lo mippene sheedut hachodesh keshera bikrovim ella sheim yimmatze echad mehen pasul mippene shehu gazlan vechayyotze bo mishshear happaslanut yitztaref hashsheni im acher veyaidu. vechol happasul leedut middivre sofrim af al pi shehu kasher min hattora pasul leedut hachodesh:

Din tora sheen medakdekin beedut hachodesh. sheafillu kiddeshu et hachodesh al pi edim venimtzeu zommin beedut zo hare ze mekuddash. lefichach hayu barishona mekabbelin edut hachodesh mikkol adam miyyisrael shekkol yisrael bechezkat kashrut ad sheyyivvada lecha shezze pasul. mishshekkilkelu habbaytosim vehayu sochrin anashim lehaid sherau vehem lo rau hitkinu shello yekabbelu bet din edut hachodesh ella meedim shemmakkirin bet din otan shehem kesherim vesheyyihyu dorshin vechokrim baedut:

Lefichach im lo yihyu bet din yodim et haedim sherau et hayyareach meshallechin anshe hair shennira bah im haedim sherau edim acherim shemmezakkin otan levet din umodiin otan sheellu kesherim hem veachar kach mekabbelin mehem:

Bet din mechashshevin badderachim shehaitztagninin mechashshevin bahem veyodin hallevana keshetterae bechodesh ze im tihye bitzfon hashshemesh o bidromah veim tihye rechava o ketzara ulehechan yihyu rashe karneha notin. uchesheyyavou haedim lehaid bodkin otam ketzad reitem otah betzafon o bedarom. lehechan hayu karneha notot. kamma hayta gevoha biriyyat enechem vechamma hayta rechava. im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanin lema shennoda bacheshbon mekabbelin otam veim lo nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanin en mekabbelin otam:

Amru haedim reinuhu bammayim o beavim o baashashit. o sherau miktzato barakia umiktzato beavim o bammayim o baashashit en zo reiyya veen mekaddeshin al reiyya zot. amar echad reitiv gavoah beenay kemo shete komot veamar hashsheni kemo shalosh komot haya gavoah mitztarfin. amar haechad kemo shalosh komot vehashsheni omer kemo chamesh en mitztarfin. umitztaref echad mehem im sheni sheyyaid kemoto o yihye benehen koma achat:

Amru reinuhu belo kavvana vechevan shehitbonannu bo venitkavvannu liroto lehaid shuv lo reinuhu en zo edut veen mekaddeshin aleha. shemma avim nitkashsheru veniru kallevana vechalu vehalchu lahem. amru edim reinuhu beyom tisha veesrim shacharit bammizrach kodem shettaale hashshemesh ureinuhu arvit bammaarav belel sheloshim hare ellu neemanim umekaddeshin al reiyya zo shehare rauhu bizmanno. aval hariyya sheamru sherauhu beshacharit en nizkakin lah sheen anu achrain liriyyat shacharit uveyadua sheheavim hem shennitkashsheru venira lahem kilvana. vechen im rauhu bizmanno uvelel ibburo lo nira hare ellu neemanin sheen anu achrain ella liriyyat lel sheloshim bilvad:

Ketzad mekabbelin edut hachodesh. kol mi sherauy lehaid sheraa et hayyareach ba levet din. uvet din machnisim otan kullan lemakom echad veosin lahen seuddot gedolot kede sheyyihyu haam regilin lavo. vezug shebba rishon bodkin otan rishon babbedikot sheamarnu. machnisin et haggadol veshoalin oto. nimtzeu devarav mechuvvanim lacheshbon machnisim et chavero. nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanin edutan kayyemet. ushear kol hazzugot shoalin otam rashe devarim. lo shetztzerichim lahem ella kede shello yetzu befache nefesh, kede sheyyihyu regilin lavo:

Veachar kach achar shettitkayyem haedut rosh bet din omer mekuddash vechol haam onim acharav mekuddash mekuddash. veen mekaddeshin et hachodesh ella bishlosha. veen mechashshevin ella bishlosha. veen mekaddeshin ella chodesh shennire bizmanno. veen mekaddeshin ella bayyom veim kiddeshuhu ballayla eno mekuddash. vafillu rauhu bet din vechol yisrael velo amru bet din mekuddash ad shechashcha lel echad usheloshim. o shennechkeru haedim velo hispiku bet din lomar mekuddash ad shechashcha lel echad usheloshim. en mekaddeshin oto veyihye hachodesh meubbar velo yihye rosh chodesh ella yom echad usheloshim af al pi shenniret belel sheloshim. sheen hariyya kovaat ella bet din sheamru mekuddash hem shekkovin:

Rauhu bet din atzman besof yom tisha veesrim. im adayin lo yatza kochav lel sheloshim. bet din omrim mekuddash sheadayin yom hu. veim rauhu belel sheloshim achar sheyyatzu shene kochavim. lemachar moshivin shene dayyanin etzel echad mehem veyaidu hashshenayim bifne hashshelosha vikaddeshuhu hashshelosha:

Bet din shekkiddeshu et hachodesh ben shoggin ben mutin ben anusim hare ze mekuddash vechayyavin hakkol letakken hammoadot al hayyom shekkiddeshu bo. af al pi shezze yodea shettau chayyav lismoch alehem sheen haddavar masur ella lahem umi shetztzivva lishmor hammoadot hu tzivva lismoch alehem shenneemar asher tikreu otam vegomer:

Edim sherau et hachodesh im haya benehem uven makom sheyyesh bo bet din mahalach layla vayom o pachot holchin umeidin. veim haya benehen yeter al ken lo yelchu sheen edutan achar yom sheloshim moelet shekkevar nitabber hachodesh:

Edim sherau et hachodesh hare ellu holchin levet din lehaid vaafillu haya shabbat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 4)</small> "asher tikreu otam bemoadam" vechol makom shenneemar moed doche et hashshabbat. lefichach en mechallelin ella al rosh chodesh nisan veal rosh chodesh tishre bilvad mippene takkanat hammoadot. uvizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam mechallelin al kullan mippene karban musaf shebbechol rosh chodesh vechodesh shehu doche et hashshabbat:

Keshem shemmechallelin haedim sherau et hachodesh et hashshabbat kach mechallelin immahen haedim shemmezakkin otan bevet din im lo hayu bet din makkirin et haroin. vaafillu haya ze shemmodia otan levet din ed echad hare ze holech immahen umechallel missafek shemma yimmatze acher veyitztaref immo:

Haya haed sheraa et hachodesh belel hashshabbat chole markivin oto al hachamor vaafillu bammitta. veim yesh lahen orev badderech lokchin haedim beyadan kele zayin. veim haya derech rechoka lokchim beyadam mezonot. vaafillu rauhu gadol venire lakkol lo yomru keshem sherinuhu anachnu rauhu acherim veen anu tzerichin lechallel et hashshabbat ella kol mi sheyyire hachodesh veyihye rauy lehaid veyihye beno uven hammakom shekkavua bo bet din layla vayom o pachot mitzva alav lechallel et hashshabbat velelech ulehaid:

Barishona hayu mekabbelin edut hachodesh bechol yom sheloshim. paam achat nishtahu haedim millavo ad ben haarbayim venitkalkelu bammikdash velo yadu ma yaasu im yaasu ola shel ben haarbayim shemma yavou haedim vei efshar sheyyakrivu musaf hayyom achar tamid shel ben haarbayim. amdu bet din vehitkinu shello yihyu mekabbelim edut hachodesh ella ad hammincha kede sheyyehe shahut bayyom lehakeriv musafin vetamid shel ben haarbayim veniskehem:

Veim higgia mincha velo bau edim osin tamid shel ben haarbayim. veim bau edim min hammincha ulemala nohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulemachar kodesh umakrivin musaf lemachar lefi shello hayu mekaddeshin oto achar mincha. mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay uvet dino sheyyihyu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom kullo vaafillu bau edim yom sheloshim besof hayyom samuch lishkiat hachamma mekabbelin edutan umekaddeshin yom sheloshim bilvad:

Keshemmeabberin bet din et hachodesh mippene shello bau edim kol yom sheloshim hayu olin lemakom muchan veosin bo seudda beyom echad usheloshim shehu rosh chodesh. veen olin lesham ballayla ella banneshef kodem alot hashshemesh. veen olin lisudda zo pachot measara. veen olin lah ella befat dagan vekitnit. veochlin beet hasseudda. vezo hi seuddat mitzva shel ibbur hachodesh haamura bechol makom:

Barishona keshehayu bet din mekaddeshin et hachodesh hayu massiin massuot berashe heharim kede sheyyedu harchokim. mishshekkilkelu hakkutim shehayu massiin massuot kede lehateot et haam hitkinu sheyyehu sheluchim yotzin umodiin larabbim. usheluchim ellu enan mechallelin et yom tov velo et yom hakkippurim veen tzarich lomar shabbat sheen mechallelin et hashshabbat lekayyemo ella lekaddesho bilvad:

Al shishsha chodashim hayu sheluchim yotzin. al nisan mippene happesach. veal av mippene hattaanit. veal elul mippene rosh hashshana. kede sheyyeshvu metzappin beyom sheloshim leelul im noda lahem shekkiddeshu bet din yom sheloshim nohagim oto hayyom kodesh bilvad. veim lo noda lahem nohagim yom sheloshim kodesh veyom echad usheloshim kodesh ad sheyyavou lahem sheluche tishre. veal tishre mippene takkanat hammoadot. veal kislev mippene chanukka. veal adar mippene happurim. uvizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam yotzin af al iyyar mippene pesach katan:

Sheluche nisan usheluche tishre en yotzin ella beyom rosh chodesh achar shettaale hashshemesh ad sheyyishmeu mippi bet din mekuddash. veim kiddeshu bet din besof yom tisha veesrim kemo sheamarnu veshamu mippi bet din mekuddash yotzin mibbaerev. usheluche shear hashshishsha chodashim yesh lahem latzet mibbaerev achar shennira hayyareach af al pi sheadayin lo kiddeshu bet din et hachodesh hoil venire hachodesh yatzu shehare lemachar bevadday mekaddeshin oto bet din:

Kol makom shehayu hashsheluchin maggiin hayu osin et hammoadot yom tov echad kakkatuv battora. umekomot harchokim sheen hashsheluchim maggiin alehem hayu osin shene yamim mippene hassafek lefi sheenam yodim yom shekkavu bo bet din et hachodesh e ze yom hu:

Yesh mekomot shehayu maggiin alehem sheluche nisan velo hayu maggiin lahen sheluche tishre. umin haddin haya sheyyaasu pesach yom echad shehare higgiu lahen sheluchin veyadu bee ze yom nikba rosh chodesh. veyaasu yom tov shel chag hassukkot shene yamim shehare lo higgiu alehen hashsheluchin. uchede shello lachalok bammoadot hitkinu chachamim shekkol makom sheen sheluche tishre maggiin sham osin shene yamim afillu yom tov shel atzeret:
Vechamma ben sheluche nisan lishluche tishre. shene yamim. sheshsheluche tishre enan mehallechin beechad betishre mippene shehu yom tov velo baasiri bo mippene shehu yom kippur:

En hashsheluchin tzerichin lihyotan shenayim ella afillu echad neeman. velo shaliach bilvad ella afillu taggar mishshear haam shebba kedarko veamar ani shamati mippi bet din shekkiddeshu et hachodesh beyom peloni neeman umetakkenin et hammoadot al piv. sheddavar ze davar heasuy lehiggalot hu veed echad kasher neeman alav:

Bet din sheyyashvu kol yom sheloshim velo bau edim vehishkimu banneshef veibberu et hachodesh kemo shebbearnu beferek ze. veachar arbaa o chamishsha yamim bau edim rechokim veheidu sherau et hachodesh bizmanno shehu lel sheloshim. vaafillu bau besof hachodesh. meayyemin alehen iyyum gadol umatrifim otam bishelot umatrichin alehen bivdikot umedakdekin beedut umishtaddelin bet din shello yekaddeshu chodesh ze hoil veyatza shemo meubbar:

Veim amdu haedim beedutan venimtzet mechuvvenet vahare haedim anashim yeduim unevonim venechkera haedut karauy. mekaddeshin oto vechozrin umonin leoto hachodesh miyyom sheloshim hoil venire hayyareach belelo:

Veim hutzrechu bet din lehanniach chodesh ze meubbar keshehaya kodem sheyyavou haedim ellu mannichin. veze hu sheamru meabberin et hachodesh letzorech. veyesh min hachachamim haggedolim mi shecholek bedavar ze veomer leolam en meabberin et hachodesh letzorech. hoil uvau edim mekaddeshin veen meayyemin alehen:

Yerae li sheen machaloket hachachamim bedavar ze ella bishar hechodashim chutz min nisan vetishre. o beede nisan vetishre shebbau achar sheavru hargalim. shekkevar naasa ma shennaasa veavar zeman hakkarbanot uzeman hammoadot. aval im bau haedim benisan vetishre kodem chatzi hachodesh mekabbelin edutan veen meayyemin alehen kelal. sheen meayyemin al edim sheheidu al hachodesh sherauhu bizmanno kede leabbero:

Aval meayyemin al edim shennitkalkela edutan vahare haddavar note ugenay shello titkayyem haedut veyitabber hachodesh. meayyemin alehen kede shettitkayyem haedut veyitkayyem hachodesh bizmanno. vechen im bau edim lehazim et haedim sherauhu bizmanno kodem shekkiddeshuhu bet din hare ellu meayyemin al hammezimin ad shello titkayyem hahazama veyitkaddesh hachodesh bizmanno:

Shanna meubberet hi shana shemmosifin bah chodesh. veen mosifin leolam ella adar veosin otah shana shene adarin adar rishon vaadar sheni. umippene ma mosifin chodesh ze mippene zeman haaviv kede sheyyehe happesach beoto zeman shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 1)</small> "shamor et chodesh haaviv" sheyyihye chodesh ze bizman haaviv. velule hosafat hachodesh hazze happesach ba peamim bimot hachamma ufeamim bimot haggeshamim:

Al shelosha simanin meabberin et hashshana. al hattekufa veal haaviv veal perot hailan. ketzad. bet din mechashshevin veyodin im tihye tekufat nisan beshishsha asar benisan o achar zeman ze meabberin otah hashshana. veyaasu oto nisan adar sheni kede sheyyihye happesach bizman haaviv. veal siman ze somchin umeabberin veen choshshin lesiman acher:

Vechen im rau bet din sheadayin lo higgia haaviv ella adayin afel hu. velo tzamchu perot hailan sheddarkan litzmoach bizman happesach. somchin al shene simanin ellu umeabberin et hashshana. veaf al pi shehattekufa kodem leshishsha asar benisan hare hen meabberin. kede sheyyihye haaviv matzuy lehakeriv mimmennu omer hattenufa beshishsha asar benisan. uchede sheyyihyu happerot tzomchin kederech kol zeman haaviv:

Veal shalosh aratzot hayu somchin baaviv. al eretz yehuda veal ever hayyarden veal haggalil. veim higgia haaviv bishte aratzot meellu uveachat lo higgia en meabberin. veim higgia beachat mehen velo higgia bishtayim meabberin im adayin lo tzamchu perot hailan. veillu hen haddevarim shehen haikkar shemmeabberin bishvilan kede sheyyihyu hashshanim shene chamma:

Veyesh sham devarim acherim shehayu bet din meabberin bishvilan mippene hatztzorech. veellu hen. mippene hadderachim sheenan metukkanin veen haam yecholin laalot meabberin et hashshana ad sheyyippasku haggeshamim vitakkenu hadderachim. umippene haggesharim shennehersu venimtzeu hanneharot mafsikin umonin et haam umistakkenin beatzman umetim meabberin et hashshana ad sheyyetakkenu haggesharim. umippene tannure pesachim sheavdu baggeshamim veen lahem makom litzlot et pischehem meabberin et hashshana ad sheyyibbanu hattannurim veyivshu. umippene galuyyot yisrael shenneekru mimmekoman vaadayin lo higgiu lirushalayim meabberin et hashshana kede sheyyihye lahem penay lehaggia:

Aval en meabberin et hashshana lo mippene hashsheleg velo mippene hatztzinna velo mippene galuyyot yisrael sheadayin lo neekru mimmekomam. velo mippene hattuma. kegon shehayu rov hakkahal o rov hakkohanim temeim en meabberin et hashshana kede sheyyihye lahem penay littaher veyaasu betohora ella yaasu betuma. veim ibberu et hashshana mippene hattuma hare zo meubberet:

Yesh devarim sheen meabberin bishvilan kelal aval osin otan saad leshana shetztzericha ibbur mippene hattekufa o mippene haaviv uferot hailan. veellu hen. mippene haggedayim vehattelaim sheadayin lo noldu o shehen meat. vmippene haggozalot shello parchu. en meabberin bishvil ellu kede sheyyihyu haggedayim vehattelaim metzuyin lifsachim vehaggozalot metzuyin liriyya o lemi shennitchayyev bekarban haof. aval osin otan saad leshana:
Ketzad osin otan saad leshana. omrin shana zo tzericha ibbur mippene hattekufa shemmashcha o mippene haaviv uferot hailan shello higgiu veod shehaggedayim ketannim vehaggozalot rakkim:

En meabberin et hashshana ella bimzummanin lah. ketzad. yomar rosh bet din haggadol lifloni ufeloni min hassanhedrin heyu mezummanin lemakom peloni shennechashshev venire veneda im shana zo tzericha ibbur o enah tzericha. veotan shehuzmenu bilvad hen shemmeabberin otah. uvechamma meabberin otah. matchilin bishlosha dayyanin mikkelal sanhedre gedola mimmi shessamchu otan. amru shenayim lo neshev velo nire im tzericha ibbur im lav veechad amar neshev venivdok. batel yachid bemiuto. amru shenayim neshev venire veechad omer lo neshev. mosifin od shenayim min hamezummanim venosim venotnin baddavar:

Shenayim omrim tzericha ibbur ushelosha omrin enah tzericha. batlu shenayim bemiutan. shelosha omrin tzericha ibbur ushenayim omrin enah tzericha ibbur. mosifin shenayim min hamezummanin lah venosin venotnin vegomrin beshiva. im gamru kullam leabber o shello leabber osin kemo sheggamru. veim nechleku holchim achar harov ben leabber ben shello leabber. vetzarich sheyyehe rosh bet din haggadol shehu rosh yeshiva shel echad veshivim mikkelal hashshiva. veim gamru bishlosha leabber hare zo meubberet vehu sheyyehe hannasi immahen o sheyyirtze. uveibbur hashshana matchilin min hatztzad. ulekiddush hachodesh matchilin min haggadol:

En moshivin leibbur hashshana lo melech velo kohen gadol. melech mippene chelotav umilchamotav shemma dato nota bishvilan leabber o shello leabber. vechohen gadol mippene hatztzinna shemma lo tihye dato nota leabber kede shello yavo tishre bime hakkor vehu tovel beyom hakkippurim chamesh tevilot:

Haya rosh bet din haggadol vehu hannikra nasi bederech rechoka en meabberin otah ella al tenay im yirtze hannasi. ba veratza hare zo meubberet. lo ratza enah meubberet. veen meabberin et hashshana ella beeretz yehuda shehashshechina betochah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 5)</small> "leshichno tidreshu". veim ibberuha baggalil meubberet. veen meabberin ella bayyom. veim ibberuha ballayla enah meubberet:

Yesh levet din lechashshev velikboa veleda e zo shana tihye meubberet bechol et sheyyirtze afillu lechamma shanim. aval en omrin shana pelonit meubberet ella achar rosh hashshana hu sheomer shana zo meubberet. vedavar ze mippene haddechak aval shello bishat haddechak en modiin shehi meubberet ella baadar hu sheomer shana zo meubberet vechodesh habba eno nisan ella adar sheni. amru lifne rosh hashshana shana zo shettikkanes meubberet enah meubberet baamira zo:

Higgia yom sheloshim baadar velo ibberu adayin hashshana lo yeabberu otah kelal. sheoto hayyom rauy lihyot rosh chodesh nisan umishsheyyikkanes nisan velo ibberu enan yecholim leabber. veim ibberuha beyom sheloshim shel adar hare zo meubberet. bau edim achar sheibberu veheidu al hayyareach hare ellu mekaddeshin et hachodesh beyom sheloshim veyihye rosh chodesh adar sheni. veillu kiddeshuhu kodem sheyyeabberu et hashshana shuv lo hayu meabberin sheen meabberin benisan:

En meabberin et hashshana bishnat reavon shehakkol ratzim levayit haggeranot leechol velichyot vei efshar lehosif lahen zeman leesor hechadash. veen meabberin bishviit sheyyad hakkol sholetet al hassefichin velo yimtzeu lekkarev haomer ushete hallechem. uregilin hayu leabber beerev sheviit:

Yerae li shezze sheamru chachamim en meabberin bishnat reavon uvishviit. shello yeabberu bahem mippene tzorech hadderachim vehaggesharim vechayyotze bahem. aval im hayta hashshana reuya lehitabber mippene hattekufa o mippene haaviv uferot hailan meabberin leolam bechol zeman:

Keshemmeabberin bet din et hashshana kotvin iggerot lechol hammekomot harchokim umodiim otan sheibberuha umippene ma ibberu. veal leshon hannasi nichtavot. veomer lahen yodea lachem shehiskamti ani vachaveray vehosafnu al shana zo kach vechach. ratzu tisha veesrim yom ratzu sheloshim yom. shechodesh haibbur harshut levet din lehosifo male o chaser laanashim harchokim shemmodiin otam. aval hem lefi hariyya hem osim im male im chaser:

Kol ma sheamarnu mikkeviot rosh chodesh al hariyya veibbur hashshana mippene hazzeman o mippene hatztzorech. en osin oto ella sanhedrin shebbeeretz yisrael o bet din hassemuchim beeretz yisrael shennatnu lahen hassanhedrin reshut. shekkach neemar lemoshe uleaharon <small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim" umippi hashshemua lamdu ish meish mimmoshe rabbenu shekkach hu perush haddavar edut zo tihye mesura lachem ulechol haomed acharechem bimkomchem. aval bizman sheen sham sanhedrin beeretz yisrael en kovin chodashim veen meabberin shanim ella becheshbon ze sheanu mechashshevin bo hayyom: 
Vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay hu. shebbizman sheyyesh sanhedrin kovin al pi hariyya uvizman sheen sham sanhedrin kovin al pi hacheshbon hazze sheanu mechashshevin bo hayyom veen nizkakin liriyya. ella peamim sheyyihye yom shekkovin bo becheshbon ze hu yom hariyya o kodem lo bayyom o acharav bayyom. veze sheyyihye achar hariyya beyom pele hu uvaaratzot shehen lemaarav eretz yisrael: 
Umeematay hitchilu kol yisrael lechashshev becheshbon ze. missof chachme haggemara beet shecharva eretz yisrael velo nishar sham bet din kavua. aval bime chachme mishna vechen bime chachme haggemara ad yeme abbayye verava al keviat eretz yisrael hayu somchin: 
Keshehayta sanhedrin kayyemet vehen kovin al hariyya. hayu bene eretz yisrael vechol hammekomot shemmaggiin alehen sheluche tishre osin yamim tovim yom echad bilvad. ushear hammekomot harchokot sheen sheluche tishre maggiin alehem hayu osim shene yamim missafek lefi shello hayu yodin yom shekkavu bo bene eretz yisrael et hachodesh: 
Bazzeman hazze sheen sham sanhedrin uvet din shel eretz yisrael kovin al cheshbon ze. haya min haddin sheyyihyu bechol hammekomot osin yom tov echad bilvad afillu hammekomot harchokot shebbechutza laaretz kemo bene eretz yisrael. shehakkol al cheshbon echad somchin vekovin. aval takkanat chachamim hu sheyyizzaharu beminhag avotehem shebbidehem: 
Lefichach kol makom shello hayu sheluche tishre maggiin elav keshehayu hashsheluchin yotzin. yaasu shene yamim vaafillu bazzeman hazze kemo shehayu osin bizman shebbene eretz yisrael kovin al hariyya. uvene eretz yisrael bazzeman hazze osin yom echad keminhagan shemmeolam lo asu shene yamim. nimtza yom tov sheni sheanu osin begaluyyot bazzeman hazze middivre sofrim shettikkenu davar ze: 
Yom tov shel rosh hashshana bizman shehayu kovin al hariyya hayu rov bene eretz yisrael osin oto shene yamim missafek. lefi shello hayu yodin yom shekkavu bo bet din et hachodesh sheen hashsheluchin yotzin beyom tov: 
Velo od ella afillu birushalayim atzmah shehu mekom bet din peamim rabbot hayu osin yom tov shel rosh hashshana shene yamim. sheim lo bau haedim kol yom sheloshim nohagin hayu beoto hayyom shemmetzappin leedim kodesh ulemachar kodesh. vehoil vehayu osin oto shene yamim vaafillu bizman hariyya hitkinu sheyyihyu osin afillu bene eretz yisrael oto tamid shene yamim bazzeman hazze shekkovin al hacheshbon. hinne lamadta sheafillu yom tov sheni shel rosh hashshana bazzeman hazze middivre sofrim: 
En asiyyat yom tov echad teluya bikrivat hammakom. ketzad. im yihye makom beno uven yerushalayim mahalach chamishsha yamim o pachot shebbevadday efshar sheyyaggiu lahen sheluchin. en omrin sheanshe makom ze osin yom tov echad. shemmi yomar lanu shehayu hashsheluchim yotzin lemakom ze. shemma lo hayu hashsheluchim yotzin lemakom ze mippene shello hayu sham yisrael veachar shechazru likboa al hacheshbon yashvu sham yisreelim shehen chayyavin laasot shene yamim. o mippene shehaya cherum badderech kederech shehaya ben yehuda vegalil bime chachme hammishna. o mippene shehayu hakkutim monin et hashsheluchin laavor benehen: 
Veillu haya haddavar taluy bikrivat hammakom hayu kol bene mitzrayim osin yom echad. shehare efshar sheyyaggiu lahem sheluche tishre. sheen ben yerushalayim umitzrayim al derech ashkelon ella mahalach shemona yamim o pachot vechen rov sureya. ha lamadta sheen haddavar taluy bihyot hammakom karov: 
Nimtza ikkar davar ze al derech zo kach hu. kol makom sheyyesh beno uven yerushalayim mahalach yeter al asara yamim gemurim osin shene yamim leolam keminhagam mikkodem. sheen sheluche kol tishre vetishre maggiin ella lemakom shebbeno uven yerushalayim mahalach asara yamim o pachot. vechol makom shebbeno leven yerushalayim mahalach asara yamim beshave o pachot sheefshar sheyyihyu sheluchin maggiin elav. roim im oto hammakom meeretz yisrael shehayu bah yisrael bishat hariyya bechibbush sheni kegon usha ushefaram veluz veyavne venov uteverya vechayyotze bahen osin yom echad bilvad. veim oto hammakom missureya kegon tzor vedammesek veashkelon vechayyotze bahen. o michutza laaretz kegon mitzrayim veammon umoav vechayyotze bahen. osin keminhag avotehen shebbidehen im yom echad yom echad veim shene yamim shene yamim: 
Makom shebbeno uven yerushalayim asara yamim o pachot measara vehu sureya o chutza laaretz veen lahem minhag. o shehi ir shennitchaddesha bemidbar eretz yisrael. o makom sheshshachnu bo yisrael atta. osin shene yamim keminhag rov haolam. vechol yom tov sheni middivre sofrim vaafillu yom tov sheni shel rosh hashshana shehakkol osin oto bazzeman hazze: 
Ze sheanu mechashshevin bazzeman hazze kol echad veechad beiro veomrin sherosh chodesh yom peloni veyom tov beyom peloni. lo bacheshbon shellanu anu kovin velo alav anu somchin. sheen meabberin shanim vekovin chodashim bechutza laaretz. veen anu somchin ella al cheshbon bene eretz yisrael ukeviatam. veze sheanu mechashshevin legallot haddavar bilvad hu. kevan sheanu yodin sheal cheshbon ze hen somchin anu mechashshevin leda yom shekkavu bo bene eretz yisrael e ze yom hu. ukeviat bene eretz yisrael oto hu sheyyihye rosh chodesh o yom tov. lo mippene cheshbon sheanu mechashshevin:

Vizman sheosin al hariyya hayu mechashshevin veyodin shaa sheyyitkabbetz bo hayyareach im hachamma bedikduk harebe kederech shehaitztagninin osin. kede leda im yerae hayyareach o lo yerae. utechillat oto hacheshbon hu hacheshbon shemmechashshevin oto bekeruv veyodin sheat kibbutzam belo dikduk ella bemahalacham haemtzai hu hannikra molad. veikkere hacheshbon shemmechashshevin bizman sheen sham bet din sheyyikbeu bo al hariyya vehu cheshbon sheanu mechashshevin hayyom hu hannikra ibbur: 
Hayyom vehallayla arba veesrim shaot bechol zeman. shetem esre bayyom ushetem esre ballayla. vehashshaa mechulleket leelef ushemonim chalakim. velamma chilleku hashshaa leminyan ze. lefi shemminyan ze yesh bo chatzi urevia usheminit ushelish ushetut vetesha vechomesh veissur. veharebe chalakim yesh lechol ellu hashshemot: 
Mishsheyyitkabbetz hayyareach vehachamma lefi cheshbon ze ad sheyyitkabbetzu paam sheniyya bemahalacham haemtzai. tisha veesrim yom ushetem esre shaot miyyom sheloshim mittechillat lelo. usheva meot ushelosha vetishim chalakim mishsheat shelosh esre. veze hu hazzeman shebben kol molad umolad veze hu chadshah shel levana: 
Shana shel levana im tihye shenem asar chodesh mechodashim ellu yihye kelalah shelosh meot yom vearbaa vachamishshim yom ushemone shaot ushemone meot veshishsha veshivim chalakim. veim tihye meubberet vetihye hashshana shelosha asar chodesh yihye kelalah shelosh meot ushemonim ushelosha yom veachat veesrim shaot vachamesh meot vetisha ushemonim chalakim. ushenat hachamma hi shelosh meot chamishsha veshishshim yom veshesh shaot. nimtza tosefet shenat hachamma al shenat hallevana asara yamim veachat veesrim shaot umatayim vearbaa chalakim: 
Keshettashlich yeme chodesh hallevana shiva shiva shehen yeme hashshavua. yishshaer yom echad ushetem esre shaot usheva meot ushelosha vetishim chalakim. siman lahem 13 793. vezo hi sheerit chodesh hallevana. vechen keshettashlich yeme shenat hallevana shiva shiva. im shana peshuta hi yishshaer mimmenna arbaa yamim ushemone shaot ushemone meot veshishsha veshivim chalakim. siman lahem 12 876. vezo hi sheerit shana peshuta. veim shana meebberet hi tihye sheeritah chamishsha yamim veachat veesrim shaot vachamesh meot vetisha ushemonim chalakim. siman lahem 26 589: 
Kesheyyihye immecha yadua molad chodesh min hechodashim vetosif alav 13 793 yetze molad sheacharav. veteda bee ze yom mime hashshavua uvee zo shaa uvechamma chalakim yihye: 
Ketzad. hare shehaya molad nisan beechad beshabbat bechamesh shaot bayyom umea veshiva chalakim siman lahem 113. keshettosif alav sheerit chodesh hallevana vehu 13 793. yetze molad iyyar belel shelishi chamesh shaot ballayla utesha meot chalakim. siman lahem 8 900. veal derech zo ad sof haolam chodesh achar chodesh: 
Vechen kesheyyihye immecha yadua molad shana zo vetosif sheeritah al yeme hammolad. im peshuta hi sheerit happeshuta veim meubberet hi sheerit hameubberet. yetze lecha molad shana shelleachareha. vechen shana achar shana ad sof haolam. vehammolad harishon shemmimmennu tatchil hu molad shehaya bashshana harishona shel yetzira. vehu haya belel sheni chamesh shaot ballayla umatayim vearbaa chalakim. siman lahem 211 umimmennu hu techillat hacheshbon: 
Bechol hacheshbonot haellu shetteda mehen hammolad. keshettosif sheerit im sheerit. kesheyyitkabbetz min hachalakim elef ushemonim tashlim shaa achat vetosif otah leminyan hashshaot. uchesheyyitkabbetz min hashshaot arba veesrim tashlim yom vetosif mimmennu leminyan hayyamim. uchesheyyitkabbetz min hayyamim yoter al shiva tashlich shiva min hamminyan vetanniach hashshear. sheen anu mechashshevin leda minyan hayyamim ella leda bee ze yom mime hashshavua uvee ze shaa vee ze chelek yihye hammolad: 
Kol tesha esre shana sheyyihyu mehen sheva shanim meebbarot ushetem esre peshutot nikra machazor. velamma samachnu al minyan ze. shebbizman sheatta mekabbetz minyan yeme shetem esre shana peshutot vesheva meebbarot usheotehen vechelkehen vetashlim kol elef ushemonim chalakim shaa. vechol arba veesrim shaot yom. vetosif leminyan hayyamim. timtza hakkol tesha esre shana mishshene hachamma shekkol shana mehen shelosh meot vachamishsha veshishshim yom veshesh shaot beshave. velo yishshaer mimminyan yeme hachamma bechol tesha esre shana chutz mishshaa achat vearba meot ushemonim vachamishsha chalakim. siman lahem 486: 
Nimtza bemachazor shehu kaze hechodashim kullam chadshe hallevana vehashshanim shene hachamma. vehashsheva shanim hameubbarot shebbechol machazor umachazor lefi cheshbon ze hem shana shelishit min hammachazor veshishshit usheminit ushenat achat esre ushenat arba esre ushenat sheva esre ushenat 19. siman lahem 17 11 14 17 19: 
Keshettekabbetz sheerit kol shana mishshetem esre shana happeshutot shehi 12 876. usheerit kol shana mishsheva shanim hameubbarot shehi 26 589. vetashlich hakkol shiva shiva yishshaer shene yamim veshesh esre shaot vachamesh meot vachamishsha vetishim chalakim. siman lahem 18 595. veze hu sheerit hammachazor: 
Kesheyyihye lecha yadua molad techillat machazor vetosif alav 18 595. yatza lecha techillat hammachazor sheacharav vechen molad kol machazor umachazor ad sof haolam. uchevar amarnu shemmolad techillat hammachazor harishon haya 241. umolad hashshana hu molad tishre shel otah hashshana: 
Uvadderech hazzot teda molad kol shana veshana shettirtze. umolad kol chodesh vechodesh shettirtze. mishshanim sheavru o mishshanim sheatidim lavo. ketzad. tikkach shene yetzira sheavru vegamru vetaase otam machazorin shel tesha esre tesha esre shana ad tishre shel otah hashshana. veteda minyan hammachazorin sheavru uminyan hashshanim sheavru mimmachazor sheadayin lo nishlam. vetikkach lechol machazor umachazor 18 595. ulechol shana veshana peshuta mishshene hammachazor shello nishlam 12 876. ulechol shana meebberet 26 589. utekabbetz hakkol vetashlim hachalakim shaot. vetashlim hashshaot yamim. vehayyamim tashlichem shiva shiva. vehannishar min hayyamim umin hashshaot vehachalakim hu molad shana habbaa shettirtze leda moladah: 
Molad hashshana sheyyetze becheshbon ze hu molad rosh chodesh tishre. ucheshettosif alav 13 793 yetze molad marcheshvan. ucheshettosif al marcheshvan 13 793 yetze molad kislev. vechen lechol chodesh vechodesh ze achar ze ad sof haolam:

En kovin leolam rosh chodesh tishre lefi cheshbon ze lo beechad beshabbat velo birvii beshabbat velo beerev shabbat. siman lahem 11. ella kesheyyihye molad tishre beechad mishshelosha yamim haellu kovin rosh chodesh bayyom shelleacharav. ketzad. hare shehaya hammolad beechad beshabbat kovin rosh chodesh tishre yom sheni. veim haya hammolad birvii kovin rosh chodesh yom chamishi. veim haya hammolad beshishshi kovin rosh chodesh bishvii: 
Vechen im yihye hammolad bachatzi hayyom o lemala mechatzi hayyom kovin rosh chodesh bayyom shelleacharav. ketzad. hare shehaya hammolad beyom sheni beshesh shaot bayyom o yeter al shesh shaot kovin rosh chodesh bishlishi. veim yihye hammolad kodem chatzi hayyom afillu bechelek echad kovin rosh hachodesh beoto yom hammolad atzmo. vehu shello yihye oto hayyom mime 11: 
Kesheyyihye hammolad bachatzi hayyom o achar chatzot veyiddache layyom shelleacharav. im yihye yom shelleacharav mime 11 hare ze nidche leshelleacharav veyihye rosh hachodesh kavua bishlishi miyyom hammolad. ketzad. hare sheyyihye hammolad beshabbat bachatzot siman 25 kovin rosh hachodesh bashshana shemmoladah kaze besheni beshabbat. vechen im haya hammolad bishlishi bachatzot o achar chatzot kovin rosh hachodesh bachamishi beshabbat: 
Molad tishre sheyyatza becheshbon ze belel shelishi betesha shaot ballayla umatayim vearbaa chalakim mishshaa asirit simanah 12 204. o yoter al ze. im hayta shana peshuta dochin et rosh hachodesh veen kovim oto bishlishi beshana zo ella bachamishi beshabbat: 
Vechen im yatza molad tishre beyom sheni beshalosh shaot beyom vetkft chalakim mishshaa reviit. simanah 17 589. o yeter al ken. im hayta otah hashshana motzae hameubberet shehayta hashshana hassemucha lah sheavra meubberet. en kovin rosh hachodesh besheni beshana zo ella bishlishi: 
Haya molad hashshana happeshuta sheamarnu shettiddache lachamishi pachot chelek echad. kegon sheyyatza simanah 12 203 o pachot mizze. kovin otah bishlishi. vechen im haya molad motzae haibbur beyom sheni pachot chelek. kegon shehaya simanah 17 588 o pachot mizze. kovin otah besheni. nimtza derech keviat rosh chodesh tishre lefi cheshbon ze kach hu. tachshov veteda hammolad bee ze yom yihye uvechamma shaot min hayyom o min hallayla uvechamma chalakim min hashshaa. veyom hammolad hu yom hakkevia leolam. ella im ken haya beechad beshabbat o birvii o beerev shabbat. o im haya hammolad bachatzot hayyom o achar chatzot. o im haya 206 chalakim mishshaa asirit millel shelishi o yoter al ze vehayta shana peshuta. o shehaya hammolad 591 chalakim mishshaa reviit miyyom sheni vehayta hashshana peshuta sheachar hameebberet. sheim yeera beechad mearbaa devarim haellu en kovin beyom hammolad ella bayyom shelleacharav o shelleachar acharav kadderech shebbearnu: 
Umippene ma en kovin becheshbon ze bime 11. lefi shehacheshbon hazze hu lekibbutz hayyareach vehashshemesh behilluchah haemtzai lo bammakom haamitti kemo shehodanu. lefichach asu yom kevia veyom dechiyya kede lifgoa beyom kibbutz haamitti. ketzad. bishlishi kovin birvii dochin. bachamishi kovin beshishshi dochin. beshabbat kovin echad beshabbat dochin. besheni kovin: 
Veikkar shear haarba dechiyyot ellu hu ze haikkar sheamarnu shehacheshbon hazze bemahalach emtzai. ureaya laddavar shehammolad yihye belel shelishi veyiddache lachamishi peamim rabbot lo yerae yareach belel chamishi velo belel shishshi mikkelal shello nitkabbetzu hashshemesh vehayyareach kibbutz amitti ella bachamishi:

Chadsha shel levana tisha veesrim yom umechetza vetshtzg chalakim kemo shebbearnu. vei efshar lomar sherosh hachodesh yihye bemiktzat hayyom ad sheyyihye miktzat hayyom mechodesh sheavar umiktzato mehabba. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 11 20)</small> "ad chodesh yamim" mippi hashshemua lamdu sheyyamim atta mechashshev lechodesh vei atta mechashshev shaot: 
Lefichach osin chadshe hallevana mehen chodesh chaser umehem chodesh male. chodesh chaser tisha veesrim yom bilvad veaf al pi shechadshah shel levana yeter al ze beshaot. vechodesh male mishsheloshim yom veaf al pi shechadshah shel levana pachot mizze beshaot. kede shello lechashshev shaot bachodesh ella yamim shelemim: 
Illu haya chadshah shel levana tisha veesrim yom umechetza bilvad hayu kol hashshanim chodesh male vechodesh chaser. veyihyu yeme shenat hallevana 354, shishsha chodashim chaserim veshishsha chodashim meleim. aval mippene hachalakim sheyyesh bechol chodesh vechodesh yoter al chatzi hayyom yitkabbetz mehen shaot veyamim. ad sheyyihyu miktzat hashshanim chodashim chaserim yoter al hammeleim uvemiktzat hashshanim chodashim meleim yoter al hachaserim: 
Yom sheloshim leolam osin oto rosh chodesh becheshbon ze. im haya hachodesh sheavar chaser yihye yom sheloshim rosh chodesh habba. veim yihye hachodesh sheavar male yihye yom sheloshim rosh chodesh hoil umiktzato rosh chodesh. veyihye tashlum hachodesh hammale sheavar. veyihye yom echad usheloshim rosh hachodesh habba umimmennu hu hamminyan. vehu yom hakkevia. ulefichach osin rashe chodashim becheshbon ze chodesh echad yom echad bilvad vechodesh echad shene yamim: 
Seder hechodashim hammeleim vehachaserim lefi cheshbon ze kach hu. tishre leolam male. vetevet leolam chaser. umittevet veelach echad male veechad chaser al hasseder. ketzad. tevet chaser shevat male. adar chaser nisan male. iyyar chaser sivan male. tammuz chaser av male. elul chaser. uveshana hameubberet adar rishon male vaadar sheni chaser:
